notes.title: Intelligent NPC trial patch based on confrontation neural network
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43185407/8aeddf44137e874de34a1612c1af181276ca8d8d.gif[/img]
[h3]This update adds some combat NPCs trained through adversarial neural networks. Intelligent NPCs have higher combat skills, such as bullet avoidance, escape, ambush and other attack methods and combat skills. Because it is only an attempt, the NPC updated this time will not appear in the mainline task. The Da Vinci model of Chat GPT will also be applied to the dialogue of camp assistants. Please look forward to it.[/h3]
